items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Jimmy Nottingham was in the Great Lakes band... I used to go out there and play with them all the time.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jimmy Nottingham was in the Great Lakes band, Dudley Brooks was in the Great Lakes band, and out here at the Santa Anna air base, all the studio musicians were at Santa Anna air base, because I used to go out there and play with them all the time. But I think that he was railroaded because, maybe part of it was his fault, I don't know -- because I was working at the Downbeat here, and I took him downtown, down on 8th Street to be inducted, and he was inducted and went to Fort MacArthur, but that night he…

I said, 'What are you doing here?' And he said, 'I jumped the wall.' You know, and so he came over the wall and I took him back, and he went back over the wall and got back in camp, but it's a thing that he could not adjust to, you know? And I think that ... it's all past now, but I do think that it was unfair because he was a musician, and at the time, the caliber of musician that you were, then you did have a chance not to be -- but they put him in just the army,
